groups.name: Down syndrome (trisomy 21)
groups.explanation: Trisomy 21 produces a recognizable pattern: endocardial cushion defects (atrioventricular septal defect), a single transverse palmar crease, and Brushfield spots on the iris.

groups.name: Cystic fibrosis
groups.explanation: An autosomal recessive CFTR mutation thickens secretions, causing bronchiectasis, pancreatic insufficiency with steatorrhea, and an elevated sweat chloride on diagnostic testing.

groups.name: DNA repair defects
groups.explanation: Four syndromes, four broken repair pathways: nucleotide excision repair (xeroderma pigmentosum), interstrand crosslink repair (Fanconi anemia), ATM-mediated double-strand break signaling (ataxia-telangiectasia), and mismatch repair (Lynch syndrome).

groups.name: Things that start with the letter P
groups.explanation: Nothing connects these but the letter P: Peyer's patches, patent ductus arteriosus, penicillin, and petechiae.

info.title: Karyotype with three copies of chromosome 21
info.text: 47,XX,+21 or 47,XY,+21, most often from maternal meiotic nondisjunction.

info.title: Atrioventricular septal defect
info.text: Endocardial cushion defect, the classic congenital heart lesion of Down syndrome.

info.title: Single transverse palmar crease
info.text: A single crease across the palm, a common dysmorphic feature of trisomy 21.

info.title: Brushfield spots
info.text: White or grayish flecks around the periphery of the iris.

info.title: Bronchiectasis
info.text: Dilated, thick-walled airways from chronic infection and mucus plugging.

info.title: Autosomal recessive pedigree
info.text: CFTR mutations (deltaF508 most common) follow autosomal recessive inheritance.

info.title: Sweat chloride test
info.text: An elevated sweat chloride (60 mmol/L or higher) is the diagnostic test.

info.title: Steatorrhea
info.text: Fatty, bulky stools from pancreatic enzyme insufficiency.

info.title: Xeroderma pigmentosum
info.text: Defective nucleotide excision repair; sun-damaged skin with early skin cancers.

info.title: Fanconi anemia
info.text: Defective interstrand crosslink repair; bone marrow failure and chromosomal breakage.

info.title: Ataxia-telangiectasia
info.text: ATM mutation impairs double-strand break repair; cerebellar ataxia, ocular telangiectasias, IgA deficiency.

info.title: Lynch syndrome
info.text: Defective mismatch repair (MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2); hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal cancer.

info.title: Peyer's patches
info.text: Lymphoid aggregates in the submucosa of the ileum.

info.title: Patent ductus arteriosus
info.text: A persistent fetal connection between the pulmonary artery and the aorta.
